scope: Three new current records and one material implementation-stage refresh; no historical correction.

changes.summary: The United States formally withdrew from the Council of Europe's GRECO anti-corruption peer-review body.
changes.duplicate_review: No same-event current record, source URL or recent maintenance item was located; withdrawals from other organizations remain distinct instruments.

changes.summary: EPA unions filed a federal complaint seeking restoration of their terminated collective-bargaining agreement.
changes.duplicate_review: The EPA-specific complaint concerns a particular contract and alleged retaliation; it is not the broader executive-order litigation or a separate employee disciplinary case.

changes.summary: U.S. forces completed their withdrawal from Iraq and formally ended the Operation Inherent Resolve mission there.
changes.duplicate_review: No same-event withdrawal-completion record was located; Iraq arms-sale and Iran-conflict records concern different actions and outcome tests.

changes.summary: The Bureau of Prisons First Step Act time-credit rule reached its September 30 effective date.
changes.duplicate_review: The effective date is the implementation stage of the already catalogued rule and was consolidated into the stable canonical record.
